claim: A keyboard entry logs a set, starts the rest clock, and files a completed workout receipt.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; enter sq and 225x5; assert the set, running timer, completed receipt, and persisted history

claim: Exercise aliases can be added and used when logging.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; add rdl for Romanian deadlift and log a set through that alias

claim: The log exports JSON and CSV and restores a compatible JSON backup.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; inspect generated JSON and CSV, reject malformed JSON, then import a valid backup

claim: A completed receipt can be copied as readable text.
sandbox: fresh browser storage and granted clipboard permission; finish one workout and assert the copied receipt text

claim: A completed receipt has a clean print or PDF view.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; finish one workout, invoke print, emulate print media, and assert receipt-only output

claim: Erase all local data removes workouts and custom aliases and restores default settings.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; create data and non-default settings, erase, reload, and assert all defaults

claim: The sample demo uses storage separate from the real workout log.
where: logger demo action and demo banner
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real set, enter and reset /demo, then return and assert the real set is unchanged

claim: Workout data stays on this device during ordinary logging, with no analytics or tracking requests.
where: logger facts, footer, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh demo flow with every request recorded; log and change settings; assert every request is same-origin

claim: The logger works offline after the first visit.
where: logger facts, manifest description, and README
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, log, and reload again

sandbox: fresh browser storage; assert the displayed price and exact Sociobot checkout URL

where: Setup, receipt view, privacy page, and README
sandbox: mocked valid Sociobot response; capture a license, set a custom rest, persist a private note, reload, and assert one verification request
